instructions: Create the next docs-only open-source readiness slice after the accepted README/feedback work. Read references/initiatives/open-source-readiness.md, references/operations/open-source-artifact-map.md, references/operations/open-source-public-docs-plan.md, README.md, .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/first-run-demo.yml, .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/workflow-feedback.yml, references/operations/open-source-release-note-draft.md, and package.json. Create references/operations/open-source-governance-package-readiness.md as a decision-complete brief for the governance and package readiness boundary before any actual top-level governance files or package metadata are changed. It must cover LICENSE, CONTRIBUTING, SECURITY, CODE_OF_CONDUCT, package metadata, package name, private: true removal, publishConfig/bin/files considerations, npm/package-runner readiness, security reporting policy, contribution scope, code of conduct scope, explicit decision debt, release gates, and the next implementation task boundary. Create references/operations/open-source-public-release-checklist.md as a concrete public release checklist that combines completed S1/S2/S3/S4/S5 evidence, first-run demo readiness, public docs readiness, governance/package readiness, dogfood-private boundary checks, release blocker checks, and stop conditions. Update references/initiatives/open-source-readiness.md to reflect that README rewrite and feedback intake are completed at accepted commit b059a2485fd17b051beb1b061c40bd64e86c4218, and that governance/package readiness is the current docs-only slice. If a specific license, package name, publishing target, SECURITY reporting channel, CONTRIBUTING policy, or CODE_OF_CONDUCT policy requires BK's direct decision, record it as decision debt and recommended options without creating or modifying those top-level files. Keep the slice docs-only. Do not rewrite README again, change package.json or bun.lockb, create LICENSE/CONTRIBUTING/SECURITY/CODE_OF_CONDUCT/CODE_OF_CONDUCT files, edit .github templates, edit source/tests/examples, move/delete references, delete runs or dogfood evidence, publish a package, or reimplement the demo command. If honest completion requires actual package publishing, top-level governance files, package metadata changes, references movement/deletion, or a changed public/private artifact boundary, stop and report the blocker instead of editing those surfaces. End with exactly one HARNESS_RESULT line.
